identity.title: History of the Christian Church, Volume I: Apostolic Christianity. A.D. 1-100
identity.author: Philip Schaff
identity.rights_evidence: The retained DC.Rights element states Public Domain; this source statement is preserved as evidence only and does not establish a human rights decision or publication authorization.

owner_route.source_map_claim: schaff-history-vol-1 is assigned to LIB-058 with the retained hcc1.xml SHA-256 above.
owner_route.member_selection_basis: The frozen owner/source map binds this named work to the exact retained hcc1 member; its hcc1 bookID/workID and Volume I title agree. The sibling Indexes root is retained as integral source support, not treated as a separate work.

work_boundary.note: The source-native Indexes root is retained as part of this complete one-member volume envelope; it is not assigned a second work ID.

selection.disposition: Include the complete ThML document, including its header, direct source front matter, three prefaces, Contents, Addenda, twelve chapters, the sibling eight-division Indexes root, notes, links, and the full source envelope. No source body division is excluded.

division_semantics.div1_roots: The first contains direct title/front matter, three prefaces, Contents, Addenda, and twelve chapters; the second contains eight named indexes.
division_semantics.div2: Five front/support divisions and twelve chapters under div1 id=i; eight index divisions under div1 id=ii.
division_semantics.div3: Content sections nested under the chapter and front/support divisions.
division_semantics.div4_through_div6: Counted explicitly; absent in this retained XML.
division_semantics.h3_through_h6: Counted explicitly; h3 and h5 are absent; one h4 and one h6 are retained source headings. CSS style declarations mentioning headings are retained as header data and are not headings.

projection.source_element_carriers: Map every source XML element one-to-one to a TEI content element and an xml:id-linked standOff record with stable source key, original local name, ordered original attributes, parent key, and one-based element-child ordinal.
projection.heading_carriers: A source h1-h6 that is the leading element child of a source division maps to TEI head; a later or otherwise non-leading source heading maps to TEI ab type=source-hN so source order remains schema-valid. The original heading tag, attributes, parent, and ordinal remain exact in standOff.
projection.division_subtype_tokens: Source division @type values are retained verbatim in standOff; the TEI @subtype projection replaces whitespace runs with hyphens because TEI subtype is token-valued.
projection.schema_order_wrappers: After a source division child, each maximal run of following non-division siblings is grouped in a TEI div type=source-order-wrapper when required by the bundled schema; exact source parent and ordinal remain in the standOff record and wrappers add no source text.
projection.mixed_content: Preserve each source element's text and tail verbatim; do not normalize spelling, punctuation, or Unicode.
projection.source_header: Retain the complete ThML.head tree as structured, tagged TEI header content; expose supported title and author fields separately in titleStmt.
projection.source_body: Retain the complete ThML.body tree, including all source divisions, headings, indexes, notes, links, verse, lists, and empty anchors.
projection.doctype: Record the exact external DOCTYPE in TEI header metadata; never fetch its external subset.
projection.comments: Retain the exact three leading XML comments as comments preceding the TEI root.
projection.rights: Preserve the retained DC.Rights string Public Domain as source evidence only; do not treat it as a human rights decision or publication authorization.
